searchText: I forgot to bring it up in the meeting, but we really should make a decision on https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/3550 I'm on the fence these days. On the one hand, I dislike any EIP talking about legal stuff at all. On the other hand, I don't think EIP editors should be in charge of deciding what legal related statements are correct/incorrect or even what is considered a "legal claim" or reference. I think the question we should ask is, "would we merge a PR that had an incorrect legal/trademark claim?" If the answer is yes, because editors don't review EIPs for accuracy, then we should merge this. If the answer is no, then we need to figure out what criteria we are using to decide whether a claim in an EIP is true or whether a claim is one that shouldn't be included in any EIP. I just pinged the EF legal team again, but I think it may be worth assuming they will not want to publicly comment now? I don't have any better view into it, sorry So, I'm mildly against moving to Last Call with unsubstantiated legal claims. IMO it's fine to have as a draft, but if it is "Final" then you want to be sure the content is accurate. I feel like it should probably fall on the champion, and not EIP editors, though, to figure out a way to get resolution there. The champion says it is accurate. 😄 I think in this case that's kind of impossible? Like, they need to devise the intention of EF legal (who own the trademark) It's different from, say, math, where anyone can replicate the work. To be fair to the author, they just say "you may need to read details about the trademark". Ok maybe I need to read the EIP again the thing that bugged me last time was insisting people use "Ethreum TM" which is clearly not true in practice Merge call now, but I can look after 🙂 Though, I think the specific claims I care less about and I'm more interested in setting a proper precedence. Should editors be blocking EIPs that have "wrong" content of any kind? Should we allow people to push EIPs through the process that are clear, but incorrect? The alternative I worry could lead to a lot of work for editors. Ok so I just re-read and I think he's wrong 🙂 Will leave a comment on the discussion-to link No answer on your meta question, though, <@!301186049323958275> https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/issues/2228#issuecomment-863251322
